commands.name: fleet-view
commands.description: Show an orchestrate run in a pane (read-only; refreshes every 15 seconds while open)

tools.name: review_launch_table
tools.description: Show orchestrate's launch table for a plan file to the operator and return their decision (approved, change with their request, cancelled, dismissed, or refused when the plan does not validate). It runs `orchestrate.py launch-table` and launches nothing: on `approved`, run `start` (or `expand` with `issue`) on that same plan file yourself. Pass `issue` when the plan expands a run in flight.

children: No run is shown. /fleet-view <issue> opens one.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
